scientific_assessment.reason: Separating selection from exploration resolves most of the v2 trade-off. The calibrated LLM prior decides who is ready, and a prior-independent floor lets a share of the rest enter anyway. With a 20 percent exploratory share, entrants are more productive than under the hand rule in all nine combinations of world and field arm, and pooled learning stays within 0.005 of the hand rule in seven of them. Without exploration, learning falls short of the hand rule in six of nine. With a 40 percent share, the precision gain disappears.
